# Super Smash Bros. Ultimate - Vert+ / Hor+ camera and UI (Eden)

Makes Smash fill any screen shape with correct proportions.

- **3D:** on a screen narrower than 16:9 (foldables like the OPPO Find N6, 4:3, 16:10) you
  keep the stock 16:9 left-right view and get extra view above and below (Vert+). On a wider
  screen (21:9, 32:9) you keep the stock vertical view and get extra view left and right
  (Hor+).
- **UI:** menus, text and the fight HUD keep their 16:9 shape instead of being stretched.
  They sit in a 16:9 band across the screen (a centered horizontal band on narrow screens),
  and UI the game parks just outside the 16:9 frame stays hidden. The fighter name tags
  still line up with the fighters. The fight HUD sits at the bottom of that band, not at
  the bottom edge of the screen.

- Emulator: **Eden** (tested: v0.2.1 stable, Android). Any yuzu-family emulator that loads
  IPSwitch `.pchtxt` exefs patches should work.
- Game version: **13.0.2 only** (title screen shows "Ver. 13.0.2"). The patch does nothing
  on other versions.
- Tested in-game: **2480x2248** (OPPO Find N6 inner screen, Vert+): title, main menu, Smash
  mode select, rulesets, stage select, character select, fights and the results screen.
  Hor+ (21:9 / 32:9) is generated by the same script but has **not** been tested in-game yet.

## Quick install (OPPO Find N6 / 2480x2248)

1. Download `smashultimate-vertplus-2480x2248-v1.1.zip` from the
   [Releases page](https://github.com/kirankunigiri/ultrawide-game-patches/releases/download/smashultimate-v1.1/smashultimate-vertplus-2480x2248-v1.1.zip)
   and extract it. (v1.0 has the camera only, without the UI fix.)
2. Copy the `VertPlus-2480x2248` folder into Eden's mod folder for Smash:
   `Android/data/dev.eden.eden_emulator/files/load/01006A800016E000/`
   (or in Eden: long-press Smash > Add-ons > Install, and pick the extracted folder).
3. In Eden, long-press Smash > Settings > Graphics > **Aspect ratio: Stretch to window**.
   This is required - the patch is designed to be stretched.
4. Launch Smash from Eden's game list (so the 13.0.2 update is applied). In Add-ons,
   `VertPlus-2480x2248` should be ticked.

## Other phones and screen sizes

The patch depends only on your screen's **shape** (aspect ratio), so make one for your
screen and install it the same way as above. Needs Python 3 on a computer; no extra packages.

1. **Find your screen shape** - any one of these works:
   - Phone connected over adb: let the script read it.
     `python3 SmashUltimate/src/make_vertplus.py --from-adb --out out/`
     (it reads `adb shell wm size`; on a foldable, unfold/fold first - it uses the screen
     that is active right now).
   - The resolution from the phone's spec sheet (e.g. 2400x1080):
     `--width 2400 --height 1080`
   - Just the ratio: `--aspect 20:9`, `--aspect 16:10` or `--aspect 1.6`
   Portrait or landscape numbers both work (it always uses landscape).
2. **Generate**: add `--out out/` to write `out/<name>/exefs/13.0.2.pchtxt`, or leave it off
   to print the patch. Narrower than 16:9 makes a `VertPlus-...` folder (extra view
   above/below), wider makes a `HorPlus-...` folder (extra view to the sides).
3. **Install** the generated folder into
   `Android/data/dev.eden.eden_emulator/files/load/01006A800016E000/` and set Smash's
   aspect ratio to **Stretch to window**, as in the quick install.
4. Only one camera patch should be ticked in Add-ons at a time.

Add `--no-ui` for the camera only (UI stays stretched, as in v1.0).

To build a release-style zip instead: `SmashUltimate/src/package.sh --aspect 20:9`
(takes the same screen options; output in `SmashUltimate/src/out/`).

| Screen | Mode | Factor (exact -> used) | Tested in-game |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2480x2248 (OPPO Find N6 inner) | Vert+ | 0.6206 -> 0.625 (+0.7%) | Yes |
| 2616x1140 (OPPO Find N6 folded/cover) | Hor+ | 0.7747 -> 0.78125 (+0.8%) | No |
| 16:10 (tablets) | Vert+ | 0.9 -> 0.90625 (+0.7%) | No |
| 4:3 | Vert+ | 0.75 -> 0.75 (exact) | No |
| 20:9 (most phones, e.g. 2400x1080) | Hor+ | 0.8 -> 0.8125 (+1.6%) | No |
| 3440x1440 (21:9) | Hor+ | 0.7442 -> 0.75 (+0.8%) | No |
| 5120x1440 (32:9) | Hor+ | 0.5 -> 0.5 (exact) | No |

The factor has to be an ARM64 `FMOV` immediate, so the script picks the nearest one and
prints how far off it is. Up to ~1.6% (a circle 1.6% wider than tall) is very hard to notice.

## Reduce input delay (recommended)

These are Eden and phone settings, not part of the patch:

| Where | Setting | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Eden > Settings > Graphics | VSync mode | **Mailbox** (default FIFO queues frames) |
| Eden > Settings > Graphics > Advanced | Async presentation | **Off** |
| Eden > Settings > Graphics > Advanced | Asynchronous GPU emulation | **Off** for lowest delay (turn back on if fights drop below 60 FPS) |
| Eden > Settings > Graphics > Advanced | Asynchronous shaders | On |
| Phone (ColorOS) | Settings > Display & brightness > Screen refresh rate | **High** (Auto select caps Eden at 60/90 Hz) |
| Phone (ColorOS) | Games app > Eden > Performance settings | Pro Gamer mode, Display: High |

Or apply the Eden ones over adb (backs up each file first, stops Eden first):

```sh
python3 SmashUltimate/src/eden_settings.py --dry-run
python3 SmashUltimate/src/eden_settings.py --oppo-refresh-high      # add --async-gpu on to keep async GPU
```

Optional, biggest single latency win: Fl4sh's **120FPS Proper** mod
(`[120FPS Definitive Edition v13.0.4]`, has a 13.0.2 file) from
[pacoa-kdbg/Switch-Emulator-Ultrawide-FPS-Mods](https://github.com/pacoa-kdbg/Switch-Emulator-Ultrawide-FPS-Mods)
runs the game at 120 FPS with normal game speed, halving Smash's built-in ~100 ms delay. It
works alongside this patch (no overlapping addresses). It doubles GPU load - use it on a
charger, and toggle it in Smash's Add-ons list (quit to Eden's game list first; add-on
changes only apply when the game starts).

## Uninstall

Untick the mod in Smash's Add-ons list (or delete its folder), and set Smash's aspect ratio
back to "Use global".

## Troubleshooting

- **Picture looks squished vertically** - Smash's aspect ratio isn't set to Stretch.
- **Nothing changes** - check the game is 13.0.2, and that Eden's log
  (`files/log/eden_log.txt`) contains `Applying IPSwitch patch from mod "VertPlus-..."`.
- **Menus and HUD look stretched** - you have the camera-only v1.0 patch, or a patch made
  with `--no-ui`. Use the current `VertPlus-...` folder.
- **Black above and below menus** - expected on a screen narrower than 16:9: menus keep
  their 16:9 shape in a centered band. Backgrounds that are 3D (stages, fighters) still fill
  the screen.
- **Fight HUD a little above the bottom of the screen** - expected: it sits at the bottom of
  the 16:9 band, so it stays lined up with the fighters' name tags (see `../notes.md`, 4.4).
- **Title screen says "Ver. 1.0.0"** - the update wasn't applied, so the patch can't apply
  either. Start Smash from Eden's game list.
- **Debug switch** - none: a `.pchtxt` is a static instruction patch with no runtime code, so
  it can't log anything.
